en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 23 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include Web3 adoption relying on accessibility improvements, a new AI model poised to enhance accessibility, Kenya's MoU to enforce disability mainstreaming in public service, transport upgrades in China's Xizang region improving accessibility, and leadership promoting housing accessibility initiatives.
